html:
G'oya

Murojaat ish vaqtidan tashqarida, agar uchta shartdan biri bajarilsa: kun shanba yoki yakshanba, soat 9 dan kichik, soat 18 yoki undan katta. Shartlar OR bilan ulanadi. Daqiqa va soniyalarga qarash shart emas: 08:59:59 ning soati 8, 18:00:00 niki esa 18.

Yechim

Hafta kuni ikkala bazada 0 dan 6 gacha, 0 yakshanba, 6 shanba. PostgreSQL'da hafta kuni va soatni EXTRACT beradi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id, customer
FROM tickets
WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM created_at) IN (0, 6)
   OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) < 9
   OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) >= 18

SQLite'da ikkalasini strftime beradi, lekin matn ko'rinishida: '0', '08'. Hafta kunini matnlar bilan, soatni esa songa aylantirib solishtiramiz:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT id, customer
FROM tickets
WHERE strftime('%w', created_at) IN ('0', '6')
   OR CAST(strftime('%H', created_at) AS INTEGER) < 9
   OR CAST(strftime('%H', created_at) AS INTEGER) >= 18

Tuzoqlar

Chegaralar: >= 18, > 18 emas. Namunadagi Dilnoza murojaatni aynan 18:00:00 da yozgan, > 18 esa butun 18-soatni, 18:59 gacha, o'tkazib yuboradi. Ertalabki chegara ham shunday: <= 9 09:00 dagi Malikani ham ish vaqtidan tashqari deb hisoblaydi.

SQLite'da strftime qaytargan matnni son bilan solishtirsangiz, xato chiqmaydi, lekin natija noto'g'ri. SQLite'da istalgan son istalgan matndan kichik, shuning uchun '08' < 9 yolg'on, '20' >= 18 esa doim rost:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, customer
FROM tickets
WHERE strftime('%w', created_at) IN (0, 6)
   OR strftime('%H', created_at) < 9
   OR strftime('%H', created_at) >= 18

Yakshanbani 7 deb yozmang: DOW uchun yakshanba 0.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da vaqtni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri solishtirish ham mumkin: created_at::time sanani tashlab, faqat vaqtni qoldiradi. ISODOW esa shanbani 6, yakshanbani 7 deb beradi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id, customer
FROM tickets
WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at) >= 6
   OR created_at::time < '09:00'
   OR created_at::time >= '18:00'

SQLite'da shunga o'xshash ishni time() qiladi, u '08:59:59' kabi matn qaytaradi:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT id, customer
FROM tickets
WHERE strftime('%w', created_at) IN ('0', '6')
   OR time(created_at) < '09:00:00'
   OR time(created_at) >= '18:00:00'
